strongest_angle: Examine how Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra outlines four distinct strategies for making concessions in negotiation to build goodwill and reciprocity.

key_facts.fact: Harvard Business School professor Deepak Malhotra published research detailing four strategies for making concessions in business negotiations.
The Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School published guidance authored by Katie Shonk outlining best practices for trading concessions effectively with counterparts.
key_facts.source_name: PON - Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

key_facts.fact: Author Katie Shonk analyzed business skills regarding how negotiators can avoid capitulation or impasse by following careful patterns when conceding.
key_facts.source_name: PON - Program on Negotiation at Harvard Law School

quotes.text: Concessions are often necessary in negotiation, but they often go unappreciated and unreciprocated.
quotes.speaker: Deepak Malhotra
